title: Murdock v. South Florida Presbytery
disposition_detail: The complaint was found administratively out of order because the complainant died on November 15, 2022, and no other person joined the original complaint; the SJC approved that decision 23-0. No merits ruling was made.
first_summary: The SJC found the complaint in Murdock v. South Florida Presbytery out of order because the complainant died on November 15, 2022, and no other person joined the complaint. The Commission approved the decision 23-0. The source provides no merits analysis.
summary: A complaint against South Florida Presbytery was held administratively out of order because its sole complainant died on November 15, 2022, and no other person joined the original complaint. The SJC adopted that disposition by a 23–0 roll-call vote. The sparse record states no underlying complaint issue, merits analysis, or further proceedings; the ruling turns on the absence of a surviving or joined complainant.
